questions.question: How long do our confidentiality obligations last under this NDA?
What happens if someone in our studio accidentally leaks Brightwater's information?
expectedAnchors: liquidated damages of Rs. 50,00,000/- (Rupees Fifty Lakh only) for each instance of breach
The Receiving Party shall be responsible for any breach of this Agreement by its Representatives.

questions.question: Can our studio take on work for another online fashion retailer while this agreement is in force?
expectedAnchors: online retail of apparel, footwear or home furnishings in India that competes with Brightwater

questions.question: Who chooses the arbitrator if we end up in a dispute with Brightwater?
expectedAnchors: a sole arbitrator to be appointed by Brightwater

questions.question: What is the difference between a mutual NDA and a one-way NDA?
Are liquidated damages clauses enforceable in India, or does the other side still have to prove its actual loss?
questions.note: A contract-law question with no contracts_nda registry keyword in it.

questions.question: The NDA says we may receive Brightwater's customer data. What are our duties under the DPDP Act for that data?
expectedAnchors: Pixelkraft shall process such personal data only for the Purpose, on the documented instructions of Brightwater
questions.note: Cross-domain question asked with the NDA attached (grounded, so outside the routing bar): the question is squarely about data-protection duties.

questions.question: One of our designers is leaving to join a competitor. Can we stop her from working there using the NDA she signed with us?
questions.note: Post-employment restraint on an employee (employment) enforced through an NDA (contracts_nda).

questions.question: A client wants me, as an individual freelancer, to sign their NDA personally instead of through my LLP. Does it bind me personally?
questions.note: 'freelancer' is a distractor; the question is about who is bound by an NDA.

questions.question: A vendor passed our pricing sheet, which was covered by our NDA, to a competitor. Can we sue them for breach and claim damages?
questions.note: 'sue' is a general litigation word; the question is about enforcing an NDA.
